title: Cannot log in after password reset
description: After resetting my password, I am unable to sign in from the web app. The system says the password is invalid even though I used the new password.
resolution: Reset the user's session and verify the password reset token was applied correctly.

title: MFA code never arrives
description: The MFA code is not arriving by SMS. I can sign in fine without MFA, but the second factor is failing repeatedly.
resolution: Confirmed the SMS gateway issue and advised the customer to use backup codes until the provider recovered.

title: Database connection timeouts
description: Our reporting jobs are failing with frequent connection timeouts to the production database. The errors appear during peak traffic windows.
resolution: Increased connection pool limits and reviewed query plans to remove lock contention.

title: Billing invoice missing from portal
description: A customer cannot see the latest invoice in the billing portal even though the payment was processed successfully.
resolution: Re-synced invoice records and confirmed the invoice status in the billing queue.

title: API returns 500 for upload requests
description: Upload requests to the content API start returning HTTP 500 after a recent release. The failure occurs when the payload exceeds a few megabytes.
resolution: Rolled back the recent upload handler patch and adjusted request size validation.
